'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { fetcher } from '../lib/api';

export default function LoginPage() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  const handleLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const data = await fetcher('/auth/login', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
      });

      if (data && data.access_token && data.user) {
        localStorage.setItem('token', data.access_token);
        localStorage.setItem('usuario', JSON.stringify(data.user));
        router.push('/dashboard');
      } else {
        setError('El servidor no devolvió los datos correctamente.');
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error(err);
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Credenciales inválidas.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-100">
      <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-lg shadow-md w-full max-w-md">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-center mb-6 text-gray-800">POS-ERP</h1>
        
        {error && (
          <div className="bg-red-100 text-red-700 p-3 rounded mb-4 text-sm font-semibold">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Email</label>
            <input
              type="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full border p-2 rounded focus:ring focus:ring-blue-200"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Contraseña</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full border p-2 rounded focus:ring focus:ring-blue-200"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full bg-blue-600 text-white py-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-blue-300 font-bold"
          >
            {loading ? 'Ingresando...' : 'Ingresar'}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\caja\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';

interface Caja {
  id: string;
  estado: string;
  montoInicial: number;
}

interface Resumen {
  montoInicial: number;
  ventasEfectivo: number;
  ingresos: number;
  egresos: number;
  saldoEsperado: number;
}

export default function CajaPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user, loading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  
  const [caja, setCaja] = useState<Caja | null>(null);
  const [resumen, setResumen] = useState<Resumen | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  // Estados para apertura
  const [montoInicial, setMontoInicial] = useState<string>('0');

  // Estados para movimientos
  const [tipoMovimiento, setTipoMovimiento] = useState<'INGRESO' | 'EGRESO'>('INGRESO');
  const [montoMovimiento, setMontoMovimiento] = useState('');
  const [motivoMovimiento, setMotivoMovimiento] = useState('');

  // Estado para cierre
  const [saldoFinal, setSaldoFinal] = useState('');

  const verificarCaja = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const data = await fetcher('/cajas/actual');
      setCaja(data);
      
      if (data) {
        const res = await fetcher('/cajas/resumen');
        setResumen(res);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (err instanceof Error && err.message !== 'Sesión expirada o no autorizada.') {
        setError('No se pudo conectar con el servidor.');
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // Solo verificar caja si el AuthContext ya terminó de cargar y hay un usuario
    if (authLoading || !user) return;
    verificarCaja();
  }, [authLoading, user]);

  const handleAbrirCaja = async () => {
    try {
      setError('');
      const nuevaCaja = await fetcher('/cajas/abrir', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ montoInicial: Number(montoInicial) })
      });
      setCaja(nuevaCaja);
      toast.success('Caja abierta con éxito');
      verificarCaja();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Error al abrir la caja';
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    }
  };

  const handleRegistrarMovimiento = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      setError('');
      await fetcher('/cajas/movimientos', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          tipo: tipoMovimiento,
          monto: Number(montoMovimiento),
          motivo: motivoMovimiento
        })
      });
      toast.success(`Movimiento de ${tipoMovimiento.toLowerCase()} registrado`);
      setMontoMovimiento('');
      setMotivoMovimiento('');
      verificarCaja();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Error al registrar movimiento';
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    }
  };

  const handleCerrarCaja = async () => {
    if (!confirm('¿Estás seguro de cerrar la caja? No podrás registrar más ventas hasta abrir una nueva.')) return;
    try {
      setError('');
      await fetcher('/cajas/cerrar', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: JSON.stringify({ saldoFinal: Number(saldoFinal) })
      });
      toast.success('Caja cerrada correctamente');
      setCaja(null);
      setResumen(null);
      setSaldoFinal('');
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Error al cerrar la caja';
      setError(msg);
      toast.error(msg);
    }
  };

  if (authLoading) return <div className="p-8 text-center">Verificando sesión...</div>;
  if (!user) return null; // AuthProvider redirige
  
  // Solo ADMIN y CAJERO pueden ver esta pantalla
  if (user.rol !== 'ADMIN' && user.rol !== 'CAJERO') {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-red-600 font-bold">No tenés permiso para acceder a la caja.</div>;
  }

  if (loading) return <div className="p-8 text-center">Cargando estado de la caja...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800">Gestión de Caja</h1>
          <Link href="/dashboard" className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">Volver al Dashboard</Link>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="bg-red-100 text-red-700 p-3 rounded mb-4">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        {!caja ? (
          <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200 max-w-md mx-auto">
            <div className="text-center mb-6 border-b pb-4">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800">Caja Cerrada</h2>
              <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm">No hay un turno activo</p>
            </div>

            <div className="mb-4">
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2 text-gray-700">Monto Inicial (Efectivo para vuelto)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={montoInicial}
                onChange={(e) => setMontoInicial(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full border p-2 rounded focus:ring focus:ring-green-200 text-gray-800"
                placeholder="0"
              />
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleAbrirCaja}
              className="w-full bg-green-600 text-white py-2 rounded hover:bg-green-700 font-bold"
            >
              Abrir Caja
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            {/* Panel de Resumen */}
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-4 border-b pb-2">Resumen del Turno</h2>
              
              <div className="space-y-3 text-gray-700">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Monto Inicial:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">${resumen?.montoInicial || 0}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Ventas en Efectivo:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-green-600">+${resumen?.ventasEfectivo || 0}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Ingresos Extra:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-green-600">+${resumen?.ingresos || 0}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Egresos / Sangrías:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-red-600">-${resumen?.egresos || 0}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between border-t pt-3 text-lg font-bold text-blue-700">
                  <span>Efectivo Esperado:</span>
                  <span>${resumen?.saldoEsperado || 0}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-8 border-t pt-4">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800 mb-3">Cerrar Caja</h3>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2 text-gray-700">Conteo Real de Efectivo</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={saldoFinal}
                  onChange={(e) => setSaldoFinal(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full border p-2 rounded focus:ring focus:ring-red-200 text-gray-800 mb-3"
                  placeholder="Ingrese el monto contado"
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleCerrarCaja}
                  disabled={!saldoFinal}
                  className="w-full bg-red-600 text-white py-2 rounded hover:bg-red-700 font-bold disabled:bg-gray-300"
                >
                  Confirmar Cierre de Caja
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Panel de Movimientos */}
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-4 border-b pb-2">Registrar Movimiento</h2>
              <form onSubmit={handleRegistrarMovimiento} className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1 text-gray-700">Tipo</label>
                  <select
                    value={tipoMovimiento}
                    onChange={(e) => setTipoMovimiento(e.target.value as 'INGRESO' | 'EGRESO')}
                    className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800"
                  >
                    <option value="INGRESO">Ingreso Extra</option>
                    <option value="EGRESO">Egreso / Retiro (Sangría)</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1 text-gray-700">Monto</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    required
                    value={montoMovimiento}
                    onChange={(e) => setMontoMovimiento(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-1 text-gray-700">Motivo</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={motivoMovimiento}
                    onChange={(e) => setMotivoMovimiento(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800"
                    placeholder="Ej: Pago a proveedor, cambio de billetes..."
                  />
                </div>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className={`w-full py-2 rounded font-bold text-white ${tipoMovimiento === 'INGRESO' ? 'bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700' : 'bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600'}`}
                >
                  Registrar {tipoMovimiento === 'INGRESO' ? 'Ingreso' : 'Egreso'}
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\campanias\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';

interface Campania { id: string; asunto: string; mensaje: string; cantidadEnviados: number; fecha: string; }

export default function CampaniasPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [campanias, setCampanias] = useState<Campania[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [asunto, setAsunto] = useState('');
  const [mensaje, setMensaje] = useState('');
  const [enviando, setEnviando] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => { cargarCampanias(); }, []);

  const cargarCampanias = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await fetcher('/campanias');
      setCampanias(data || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCrearCampania = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setEnviando(true);
    try {
      await fetcher('/campanias', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ asunto, mensaje }) });
      toast.success('¡Campaña enviada con éxito a todos los clientes!');
      setAsunto(''); setMensaje('');
      cargarCampanias();
    } catch (error: any) { toast.error(error.message || 'Error al enviar la campaña'); } finally { setEnviando(false); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center">Cargando campañas...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800">Campañas de Marketing</h1>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">Volver al Dashboard</button>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-gray-800">Enviar Nueva Promoción</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-4">Este mensaje se enviará a todos los clientes registrados en la base de datos.</p>
          <form onSubmit={handleCrearCampania} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Asunto</label>
              <input type="text" placeholder="Ej: ¡20% de descuento este fin de semana!" required value={asunto} onChange={e => setAsunto(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Mensaje</label>
              <textarea placeholder="Hola! Te esperamos este viernes con una promo especial..." required value={mensaje} onChange={e => setMensaje(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800 h-32 resize-none" />
            </div>
            <button type="submit" disabled={enviando} className="bg-pink-600 text-white font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded hover:bg-pink-700 disabled:bg-pink-300 transition">{enviando ? 'Enviando...' : 'Enviar Campaña'}</button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-b">
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Fecha</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Asunto</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Mensaje</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold text-center">Enviados</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {campanias.map(camp => (
                <tr key={camp.id} className="border-b hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-800">
                  <td className="p-4 text-sm text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">{new Date(camp.fecha).toLocaleString('es-AR')}</td>
                  <td className="p-4 font-medium">{camp.asunto}</td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-sm text-gray-600 truncate max-w-xs">{camp.mensaje}</td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-center"><span className="bg-pink-100 text-pink-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold">{camp.cantidadEnviados} clientes</span></td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {campanias.length === 0 && <tr><td colSpan={4} className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500">No hay campañas enviadas aún.</td></tr>}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

interface PedidoDetalle {
  id: string;
  cantidad: number;
  precioUnitario: number;
  producto: {
    nombre: string;
  };
}

interface Pedido {
  id: string;
  total: number;
  createdAt: string;
  detalles: PedidoDetalle[];
}

export default function HistorialPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pedidos, setPedidos] = useState<Pedido[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (!token) {
      router.push('/');
      return;
    }

    fetch('/api/pedidos', {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
    })
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        setPedidos(data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error(err);
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [router]);

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center">Cargando historial...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800">Historial de Ventas</h1>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">
            Volver al Dashboard
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-b">
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Fecha</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Detalle del Pedido</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold text-right">Total</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {pedidos.map(pedido => (
                <tr key={pedido.id} className="border-b hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-800">
                  <td className="p-4 text-sm text-gray-500">
                    {new Date(pedido.createdAt).toLocaleString('es-AR')}
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4">
                    <ul className="list-disc list-inside text-sm">
                      {pedido.detalles.map((det, index) => (
                        <li key={index}>
                          {det.cantidad}x {det.producto?.nombre || 'Producto eliminado'} 
                          (${det.precioUnitario} c/u)
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-right font-bold text-green-600 text-lg">
                    ${Number(pedido.total).toFixed(2)}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {pedidos.length === 0 && (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={3} className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500">
                    Todavía no hay ventas registradas.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\cocina\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';

interface PedidoDetalle { id: string; cantidad: number; notas?: string; producto: { nombre: string }; }
interface Pedido { id: string; createdAt: string; mesa?: { nombre: string }; detalles: PedidoDetalle[]; }

export default function CocinaPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pedidos, setPedidos] = useState<Pedido[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const sucursalActiva = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sucursalActiva') : '';

  useEffect(() => {
    const cargarPedidos = async () => {
      try {
        const url = sucursalActiva ? `/pedidos/cocina?sucursalId=${sucursalActiva}` : '/pedidos/cocina';
        const data = await fetcher(url);
        if (data) setPedidos(data);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
    };

    cargarPedidos();
    const interval = setInterval(cargarPedidos, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [sucursalActiva]);

  const handleMarcarListo = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      await fetcher(`/pedidos/${id}/cocina`, { method: 'PATCH' });
      setPedidos(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== id));
    } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-2xl">Cargando comandas...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white p-6">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-8 border-b border-gray-700 pb-4">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-green-400">Monitor de Cocina (KDS)</h1>
        <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white underline">Volver al Dashboard</button>
      </div>

      {pedidos.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center mt-32 text-gray-500">
          <svg className="w-24 h-24 mb-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>
          <p className="text-2xl">No hay comandas pendientes</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          {pedidos.map(pedido => (
            <div key={pedido.id} className="bg-gray-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-gray-700 shadow-2xl flex flex-col">
              <div className="bg-yellow-500 text-black p-3 flex justify-between items-center font-bold text-lg">
                <span>{pedido.mesa?.nombre || 'Mostrador'}</span>
                <span>{new Date(pedido.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-4 flex-1">
                <ul className="space-y-3">
                  {pedido.detalles.map(det => (
                    <li key={det.id} className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xl border-b border-gray-700 pb-2">
                      <div className="flex gap-3"><span className="font-bold text-green-400">{det.cantidad}x</span><span>{det.producto.nombre}</span></div>
                      {det.notas && <div className="text-sm font-bold text-yellow-400 bg-yellow-400/10 px-2 py-1 rounded inline-block w-fit">⚠ {det.notas}</div>}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
              <div className="p-4 bg-gray-850">
                <button onClick={() => handleMarcarListo(pedido.id)} className="w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 text-white font-bold py-3 text-xl rounded-lg transition">✓ Marcar Listo</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\compras\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';

interface Proveedor { id: string; nombre: string; }
interface Insumo { id: string; nombre: string; unidadMedida: string; costo: number; }
interface ItemCompra { insumoId: string; nombre: string; cantidad: number; costoUnitario: number; }

export default function ComprasPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [proveedores, setProveedores] = useState<Proveedor[]>([]);
  const [insumos, setInsumos] = useState<Insumo[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [proveedorId, setProveedorId] = useState('');
  const [insumoId, setInsumoId] = useState('');
  const [cantidad, setCantidad] = useState('');
  const [costoUnitario, setCostoUnitario] = useState('');
  const [carrito, setCarrito] = useState<ItemCompra[]>([]);

  // Función movida arriba del useEffect
  const cargarDatos = async () => {
    try {
      const [provs, inss] = await Promise.all([fetcher('/proveedores'), fetcher('/insumos')]);
      setProveedores(provs || []);
      setInsumos(inss || []);
      if (provs && provs.length > 0) setProveedorId(provs[0].id);
      if (inss && inss.length > 0) {
        setInsumoId(inss[0].id);
        setCostoUnitario(inss[0].costo.toString());
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { 
    cargarDatos(); 
  }, []);

  const handleInsumoChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const id = e.target.value;
    setInsumoId(id);
    const insumoSeleccionado = insumos.find(i => i.id === id);
    if (insumoSeleccionado) setCostoUnitario(insumoSeleccionado.costo.toString());
  };

  const agregarAlCarrito = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!insumoId || !cantidad || !costoUnitario) return;
    const insumoObj = insumos.find(i => i.id === insumoId);
    if (!insumoObj) return;

    const nuevoItem: ItemCompra = { insumoId, nombre: insumoObj.nombre, cantidad: Number(cantidad), costoUnitario: Number(costoUnitario) };

    const existeIndex = carrito.findIndex(item => item.insumoId === insumoId);
    if (existeIndex >= 0) {
      const nuevoCarrito = [...carrito];
      nuevoCarrito[existeIndex].cantidad += Number(cantidad);
      nuevoCarrito[existeIndex].costoUnitario = Number(costoUnitario);
      setCarrito(nuevoCarrito);
    } else {
      setCarrito([...carrito, nuevoItem]);
    }
    setCantidad('');
  };

  const calcularTotal = () => carrito.reduce((total, item) => total + (item.cantidad * item.costoUnitario), 0);

  const handleRegistrarCompra = async () => {
    if (!proveedorId) return toast.error('Seleccioná un proveedor');
    if (carrito.length === 0) return toast.error('Agregá al menos un insumo');

    try {
      // OJO: Ya no enviamos 'total' porque el backend lo calcula por seguridad (Punto 11 auditoría)
      await fetcher('/compras', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          proveedorId,
          detalles: carrito.map(item => ({ insumoId: item.insumoId, cantidad: item.cantidad, costoUnitario: item.costoUnitario }))
        })
      });
      toast.success('¡Compra registrada con éxito!');
      setCarrito([]);
      const inss = await fetcher('/insumos');
      setInsumos(inss || []);
    } catch (error: unknown) { 
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Error al registrar la compra'); 
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center">Cargando...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-6">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800">Registrar Compra</h1>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">Volver al Dashboard</button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-6">
          <div className="lg:w-1/2 space-y-6">
            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800 mb-4">1. Seleccionar Proveedor</h2>
              <select value={proveedorId} onChange={e => setProveedorId(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-3 rounded text-gray-800 font-bold bg-gray-50">
                <option value="">Seleccione un proveedor...</option>
                {proveedores.map(p => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.nombre}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800 mb-4">2. Agregar Insumos</h2>
              <form onSubmit={agregarAlCarrito} className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Insumo</label>
                  <select value={insumoId} onChange={handleInsumoChange} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800">
                    {insumos.map(ins => <option key={ins.id} value={ins.id}>{ins.nombre} ({ins.unidadMedida})</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-4">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <label className="block text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Cantidad</label>
                    <input type="number" step="0.01" required value={cantidad} onChange={e => setCantidad(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" placeholder="Ej: 10" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <label className="block text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Costo Unitario</label>
                    <input type="number" step="0.01" required value={costoUnitario} onChange={e => setCostoUnitario(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button type="submit" className="w-full bg-gray-800 text-white font-bold p-2 rounded hover:bg-gray-900">+ Agregar a la Compra</button>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:w-1/2">
            <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden h-full flex flex-col">
              <div className="bg-gray-800 text-white p-4"><h2 className="text-xl font-bold">Resumen de la Factura</h2></div>
              <div className="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto">
                {carrito.length === 0 ? <p className="text-gray-400 text-center mt-10">No hay insumos agregados</p> : (
                  <ul className="space-y-3">
                    {carrito.map(item => (
                      <li key={item.insumoId} className="flex justify-between items-center border-b pb-2">
                        <div>
                          <p className="font-semibold text-gray-800">{item.nombre}</p>
                          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">{item.cantidad} x ${item.costoUnitario}</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">${item.cantidad * item.costoUnitario}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="p-6 bg-gray-50 border-t">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-2xl font-bold mb-4 text-gray-800"><span>Total:</span><span>${calcularTotal()}</span></div>
                <button onClick={handleRegistrarCompra} disabled={carrito.length === 0 || !proveedorId} className="w-full bg-blue-600 text-white py-3 rounded-lg text-lg font-bold hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:bg-gray-300">Registrar Compra y Actualizar Stock</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\dashboard\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, PieChart, Pie, Cell } from 'recharts';

interface Resumen {
  totalVentas: number;
  cantidadPedidos: number;
  metodosPago: { name: string; value: number }[];
  topProductos: { nombre: string; cantidad: number; total: number }[];
}

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const { user, loading: authLoading, logout } = useAuth();
  const [resumen, setResumen] = useState<Resumen | null>(null);
  const [loadingData, setLoadingData] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading || !user) return;

    fetcher('/reportes/resumen')
      .then((data) => {
        setResumen(data);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error('Error cargando resumen:', err);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        setLoadingData(false);
      });
  }, [user, authLoading]);

  if (authLoading || (user && loadingData)) {
    return <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center">Cargando dashboard...</div>;
  }

  if (!user) return null;

  const COLORS = ['#0088FE', '#00C49F', '#FFBB28', '#FF8042'];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-8 bg-white p-4 rounded-lg shadow">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">Dashboard</h1>
            <p className="text-gray-500">Bienvenido, {user.email} ({user.rol})</p>
          </div>
          <div className="space-x-4">
            <Link href="/caja" className="bg-green-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded hover:bg-green-700">
              Ir a Caja
            </Link>
            {/* CORREGIDO: Envuelto en función de flecha */}
            <button onClick={() => logout()} className="bg-red-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded hover:bg-red-700">
              Cerrar Sesión
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-8">
          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow border-l-4 border-blue-500">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-600">Ventas Totales</h2>
            <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">
              ${resumen?.totalVentas?.toLocaleString('es-AR') || 0}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow border-l-4 border-green-500">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-600">Cantidad de Pedidos</h2>
            <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">
              {resumen?.cantidadPedidos || 0}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-600 mb-4">Ventas por Método de Pago</h2>
            <div className="h-64">
              {resumen?.metodosPago?.length ? (
                <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                  <PieChart>
                    <Pie
                      data={resumen.metodosPago}
                      dataKey="value"
                      nameKey="name"
                      cx="50%"
                      cy="50%"
                      outerRadius={80}
                      label
                    >
                      {resumen.metodosPago.map((entry, index: number) => (
                        <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={COLORS[index % COLORS.length]} />
                      ))}
                    </Pie>
                    <Tooltip />
                  </PieChart>
                </ResponsiveContainer>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-center text-gray-400 mt-10">No hay ventas registradas</p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-600 mb-4">Top 5 Productos</h2>
            <div className="h-64">
              {resumen?.topProductos?.length ? (
                <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                  <BarChart data={resumen.topProductos}>
                    <XAxis dataKey="nombre" />
                    <YAxis />
                    <Tooltip />
                    <Bar dataKey="cantidad" fill="#8884d8" />
                  </BarChart>
                </ResponsiveContainer>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-center text-gray-400 mt-10">No hay productos vendidos</p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\delivery\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';

interface PedidoDetalle { id: string; cantidad: number; notas?: string; producto: { nombre: string }; }
interface PedidoDelivery { id: string; total: number; createdAt: string; direccionEntrega: string; costoEnvio: number; cliente?: { nombre: string, telefono?: string }; detalles: PedidoDetalle[]; }

export default function DeliveryPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pedidos, setPedidos] = useState<PedidoDelivery[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const sucursalActiva = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sucursalActiva') : '';

  useEffect(() => {
    const cargarPedidos = async () => {
      try {
        const url = sucursalActiva ? `/pedidos/delivery?sucursalId=${sucursalActiva}` : '/pedidos/delivery';
        const data = await fetcher(url);
        if (data) setPedidos(data);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
    };

    cargarPedidos();
    const interval = setInterval(cargarPedidos, 10000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [sucursalActiva]);

  const handleMarcarEnviado = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('¿Despachar este pedido a la dirección indicada?')) return;
    try {
      await fetcher(`/pedidos/${id}/delivery`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ estadoDelivery: 'ENVIADO' }) });
      setPedidos(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== id));
    } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center text-xl">Buscando pedidos de delivery...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-3">🛵 Despacho de Delivery</h1>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">Volver al Dashboard</button>
        </div>

        {pedidos.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-white p-12 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 text-center">
            <svg className="w-24 h-24 mx-auto text-gray-300 mb-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-600 mb-2">No hay pedidos pendientes</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-500">Todos los envíos están al día.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
            {pedidos.map(pedido => (
              <div key={pedido.id} className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-md border border-orange-200 overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
                <div className="bg-orange-500 text-white p-4 flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="font-bold text-lg">Pedido #{pedido.id.slice(0, 4).toUpperCase()}</span>
                  <span className="text-sm bg-orange-600 px-2 py-1 rounded">{new Date(pedido.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-5 flex-1">
                  <div className="mb-4 bg-gray-50 p-3 rounded border border-gray-100">
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">Dirección de entrega:</p>
                    <p className="font-bold text-gray-800 text-lg leading-tight mb-2">{pedido.direccionEntrega}</p>
                    {pedido.cliente && <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">👤 {pedido.cliente.nombre} {pedido.cliente.telefono ? `- 📞 ${pedido.cliente.telefono}` : ''}</p>}
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2 mb-4">
                    {pedido.detalles.map(det => (
                      <div key={det.id} className="flex justify-between text-sm"><span className="text-gray-700"><span className="font-bold">{det.cantidad}x</span> {det.producto.nombre}</span></div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-4 bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-200">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 text-lg font-bold">
                    <span className="text-gray-600">Total (con envío):</span>
                    <span className="text-green-600">${Number(pedido.total).toFixed(2)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <button onClick={() => handleMarcarEnviado(pedido.id)} className="w-full bg-gray-900 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-black transition">Marcar como Enviado</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\empleados\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

interface Sucursal {
  id: string;
  nombre: string;
}

interface Empleado {
  id: string;
  nombre: string;
  email: string;
  rol: string;
  sucursal?: Sucursal;
}

export default function EmpleadosPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [empleados, setEmpleados] = useState<Empleado[]>([]);
  const [sucursales, setSucursales] = useState<Sucursal[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  const [nombre, setNombre] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [rol, setRol] = useState('CAJERO');
  const [sucursalId, setSucursalId] = useState('');

  const token = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('token') : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!token) {
      router.push('/');
      return;
    }
    cargarDatos();
  }, [router, token]);

  const cargarDatos = async () => {
    try {
      const [resEmp, resSuc] = await Promise.all([
        fetch('/api/usuarios', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }),
        fetch('/api/sucursales', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
      ]);
      setEmpleados(await resEmp.json());
      const sucs = await resSuc.json();
      setSucursales(sucs);
      if (sucs.length > 0) setSucursalId(sucs[0].id);
      setLoading(false);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCrearEmpleado = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/usuarios', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        body: JSON.stringify({ nombre, email, password, rol, sucursalId: sucursalId || null })
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        alert('Empleado creado con éxito');
        setNombre(''); setEmail(''); setPassword('');
        cargarDatos();
      } else {
        alert('Error al crear el empleado. Verificá si el email ya existe.');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center">Cargando...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800">Gestión de Empleados</h1>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">
            Volver al Dashboard
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-gray-800">Agregar Nuevo Empleado</h2>
          <form onSubmit={handleCrearEmpleado} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-6 gap-4">
            <input
              type="text" placeholder="Nombre" required value={nombre} onChange={e => setNombre(e.target.value)}
              className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800"
            />
            <input
              type="email" placeholder="Email" required value={email} onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800"
            />
            <input
              type="password" placeholder="Contraseña" required value={password} onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800"
            />
            <select value={rol} onChange={e => setRol(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800">
              <option value="ADMIN">Administrador</option>
              <option value="CAJERO">Cajero / Mozo</option>
              <option value="COCINERO">Cocinero</option>
            </select>
            <select value={sucursalId} onChange={e => setSucursalId(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800">
              <option value="">Sin Sucursal</option>
              {sucursales.map(suc => (
                <option key={suc.id} value={suc.id}>{suc.nombre}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <button type="submit" className="bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold p-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-700">
              Guardar
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-b">
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Nombre</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Email</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Rol</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Sucursal</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {empleados.map(emp => (
                <tr key={emp.id} className="border-b hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-800">
                  <td className="p-4 font-medium">{emp.nombre}</td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-gray-500">{emp.email}</td>
                  <td className="p-4">
                    <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold ${emp.rol === 'ADMIN' ? 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700' : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700'}`}>
                      {emp.rol}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-gray-600">{emp.sucursal?.nombre || 'Global'}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\historial\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

interface PedidoDetalle {
  id: string;
  cantidad: number;
  precioUnitario: number;
  notas?: string;
  producto: { nombre: string };
}

interface Pedido {
  id: string;
  total: number;
  createdAt: string;
  metodoPago: string;
  tipoFactura?: string;
  cuitFactura?: string;
  razonSocialFactura?: string;
  mesa?: { nombre: string };
  cliente?: { nombre: string };
  detalles: PedidoDetalle[];
}

export default function HistorialPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pedidos, setPedidos] = useState<Pedido[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Filtros
  const [busqueda, setBusqueda] = useState('');
  const [filtroMetodoPago, setFiltroMetodoPago] = useState('TODOS');

  const token = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('token') : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!token) {
      router.push('/');
      return;
    }

    fetch('/api/pedidos', {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
    })
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => {
        setPedidos(data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error(err);
        setLoading(false);
      });
  }, [router, token]);

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center">Cargando historial...</div>;

  // Aplicamos los filtros
  const pedidosFiltrados = pedidos.filter(pedido => {
    // Filtro por método de pago
    if (filtroMetodoPago !== 'TODOS' && pedido.metodoPago !== filtroMetodoPago) {
      return false;
    }

    // Filtro por texto (busca en cliente, mesa, cuit o productos)
    if (busqueda) {
      const busquedaLower = busqueda.toLowerCase();
      
      const coincideCliente = pedido.cliente?.nombre.toLowerCase().includes(busquedaLower);
      const coincideMesa = pedido.mesa?.nombre.toLowerCase().includes(busquedaLower);
      const coincideCuit = pedido.cuitFactura?.includes(busqueda);
      const coincideRazon = pedido.razonSocialFactura?.toLowerCase().includes(busquedaLower);
      const coincideProducto = pedido.detalles.some(d => d.producto?.nombre.toLowerCase().includes(busquedaLower));

      if (!coincideCliente && !coincideMesa && !coincideCuit && !coincideRazon && !coincideProducto) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800">Historial de Ventas</h1>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">
            Volver al Dashboard
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* BARRA DE FILTROS */}
        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200 flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center">
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-[250px]">
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Buscar por cliente, producto, CUIT..."
              value={busqueda}
              onChange={e => setBusqueda(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800"
            />
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <label className="text-sm text-gray-600 font-medium">Pago:</label>
            <select
              value={filtroMetodoPago}
              onChange={e => setFiltroMetodoPago(e.target.value)}
              className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800"
            >
              <option value="TODOS">Todos los medios</option>
              <option value="EFECTIVO">Efectivo</option>
              <option value="TARJETA">Tarjeta</option>
              <option value="TRANSFERENCIA">Transferencia / QR</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <button 
            onClick={() => { setBusqueda(''); setFiltroMetodoPago('TODOS'); }}
            className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 underline ml-auto"
          >
            Limpiar filtros
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-b">
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Fecha / Hora</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Comprobante</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Cliente / Origen</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Detalle</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Pago</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold text-right">Total</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {pedidosFiltrados.map(pedido => (
                <tr key={pedido.id} className="border-b hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-800 text-sm">
                  <td className="p-4 text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {new Date(pedido.createdAt).toLocaleString('es-AR')}
                  </td>
                  
                  {/* COLUMNA FACTURA */}
                  <td className="p-4">
                    <div className="font-bold">{pedido.tipoFactura ? pedido.tipoFactura.replace('_', ' ') : 'FACTURA B'}</div>
                    {pedido.cuitFactura && <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">CUIT: {pedido.cuitFactura}</div>}
                  </td>

                  {/* COLUMNA CLIENTE Y MESA */}
                  <td className="p-4">
                    <div className="font-medium">{pedido.cliente ? pedido.cliente.nombre : 'Consumidor Final'}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                      {pedido.mesa ? `Mesa: ${pedido.mesa.nombre}` : 'Mostrador'}
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-4">
                    <ul className="list-disc list-inside text-xs text-gray-600">
                      {pedido.detalles.map((det, index) => (
                        <li key={index} className="mb-1">
                          {det.cantidad}x {det.producto?.nombre || 'Producto Eliminado'}
                          {det.notas && <span className="text-blue-500 ml-1">({det.notas})</span>}
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </td>

                  <td className="p-4">
                    <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold ${
                      pedido.metodoPago === 'EFECTIVO' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700' : 
                      pedido.metodoPago === 'TARJETA' ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700' : 
                      'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700'
                    }`}>
                      {pedido.metodoPago}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-right font-bold text-green-600">
                    ${Number(pedido.total).toFixed(2)}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {pedidosFiltrados.length === 0 && (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={6} className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500">
                    No se encontraron ventas que coincidan con los filtros.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\insumos\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';

interface Insumo { id: string; nombre: string; unidadMedida: string; stock: number; costo: number; }

export default function InsumosPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [insumos, setInsumos] = useState<Insumo[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [nombre, setNombre] = useState('');
  const [unidadMedida, setUnidadMedida] = useState('UNIDAD');
  const [stock, setStock] = useState('');
  const [costo, setCosto] = useState('');

  // Función movida arriba del useEffect
  const cargarInsumos = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await fetcher('/insumos');
      setInsumos(data || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { 
    cargarInsumos(); 
  }, []);

  const handleCrearInsumo = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await fetcher('/insumos', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ nombre, unidadMedida, stock: Number(stock), costo: Number(costo) })
      });
      toast.success('Insumo creado con éxito');
      setNombre(''); setUnidadMedida('UNIDAD'); setStock(''); setCosto('');
      cargarInsumos();
    } catch (error: unknown) { 
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Error al crear el insumo'); 
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center">Cargando...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800">Materias Primas e Insumos</h1>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">Volver al Dashboard</button>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-gray-800">Agregar Nuevo Insumo</h2>
          <form onSubmit={handleCrearInsumo} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
            <input type="text" placeholder="Nombre (Ej: Pan de burger)" required value={nombre} onChange={e => setNombre(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            <select value={unidadMedida} onChange={e => setUnidadMedida(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800">
              <option value="UNIDAD">Unidad</option>
              <option value="KG">Kilogramos</option>
              <option value="GRAMOS">Gramos</option>
              <option value="LITROS">Litros</option>
              <option value="ML">Mililitros</option>
            </select>
            <input type="number" placeholder="Stock Inicial" required value={stock} onChange={e => setStock(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            <input type="number" placeholder="Costo por unidad" required value={costo} onChange={e => setCosto(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            <button type="submit" className="bg-teal-600 text-white font-bold p-2 rounded hover:bg-teal-700">Guardar Insumo</button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-b">
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Insumo</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Unidad</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Costo</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Stock</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {insumos.map(insumo => (
                <tr key={insumo.id} className="border-b hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-800">
                  <td className="p-4 font-medium">{insumo.nombre}</td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-gray-500">{insumo.unidadMedida}</td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-teal-600 font-bold">${insumo.costo}</td>
                  <td className="p-4">
                    <span className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold ${insumo.stock > 10 ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'}`}>{insumo.stock} {insumo.unidadMedida.toLowerCase()}</span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {insumos.length === 0 && <tr><td colSpan={4} className="p-4 text-center text-gray-500">No hay insumos cargados</td></tr>}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\kiosco\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';

interface Categoria { id: string; nombre: string; }
interface Producto { id: string; nombre: string; precio: number; categoriaId?: string; }
interface ItemCarrito extends Producto { cantidad: number; }

export default function KioscoPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [productos, setProductos] = useState<Producto[]>([]);
  const [categorias, setCategorias] = useState<Categoria[]>([]);
  const [categoriaActiva, setCategoriaActiva] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [carrito, setCarrito] = useState<ItemCarrito[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [pedidoExitoso, setPedidoExitoso] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const cargarDatos = async () => {
      try {
        const [prods, cats] = await Promise.all([fetcher('/productos'), fetcher('/categorias')]);
        setProductos(prods || []);
        setCategorias(cats || []);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    cargarDatos();
  }, []);

  const agregarAlCarrito = (producto: Producto) => {
    setCarrito(prev => {
      const existe = prev.find(item => item.id === producto.id);
      if (existe) return prev.map(item => item.id === producto.id ? { ...item, cantidad: item.cantidad + 1 } : item);
      return [...prev, { ...producto, cantidad: 1 }];
    });
  };

  const quitarDelCarrito = (productoId: string) => {
    setCarrito(prev => {
      const existe = prev.find(item => item.id === productoId);
      if (existe && existe.cantidad > 1) return prev.map(item => item.id === productoId ? { ...item, cantidad: item.cantidad - 1 } : item);
      return prev.filter(item => item.id !== productoId);
    });
  };

  const calcularTotal = () => carrito.reduce((total, item) => total + (item.precio * item.cantidad), 0);

  const confirmarPedido = async () => {
    if (carrito.length === 0) return;
    try {
      const ventaData = await fetcher('/pedidos', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          estado: 'ABIERTO',
          metodoPago: 'PENDIENTE',
          mesaId: null,
          detalles: carrito.map(item => ({ productoId: item.id, cantidad: item.cantidad }))
        })
      });
      if (ventaData) {
        setPedidoExitoso(ventaData.id.slice(0, 4).toUpperCase());
        setCarrito([]);
        setTimeout(() => setPedidoExitoso(null), 8000);
      }
    } catch (error) { alert('Error al procesar el pedido'); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-900 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-3xl font-bold">Cargando menú...</div>;

  if (pedidoExitoso) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-yellow-500 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-white p-8">
        <svg className="w-32 h-32 mb-8 animate-bounce" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>
        <h1 className="text-5xl font-bold mb-4">¡Pedido Registrado!</h1>
        <p className="text-2xl mb-8">Por favor, pasá por caja a abonar.</p>
        <div className="bg-white text-gray-900 px-12 py-6 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl">
          <p className="text-xl text-center font-medium mb-2">TU NÚMERO DE ORDEN</p>
          <p className="text-8xl font-black text-center tracking-widest">{pedidoExitoso}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const productosFiltrados = categoriaActiva === 'ALL' ? productos : productos.filter(p => p.categoriaId === categoriaActiva);

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen bg-gray-50 overflow-hidden font-sans">
      <div className="w-2/3 flex flex-col">
        <div className="bg-white p-6 shadow-sm flex justify-between items-center z-10">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-gray-800 tracking-tight">Bienvenido</h1>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-sm text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700">Salir</button>
        </div>
        <div className="p-6 pb-2 flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto bg-gray-50">
          <button onClick={() => setCategoriaActiva('ALL')} className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-lg whitespace-nowrap transition ${categoriaActiva === 'ALL' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg' : 'bg-white text-gray-600 shadow-sm hover:bg-gray-100'}`}>Ver Todo</button>
          {categorias.map(cat => (
            <button key={cat.id} onClick={() => setCategoriaActiva(cat.id)} className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-lg whitespace-nowrap transition ${categoriaActiva === cat.id ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg' : 'bg-white text-gray-600 shadow-sm hover:bg-gray-100'}`}>{cat.nombre}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
            {productosFiltrados.map(prod => (
              <button key={prod.id} onClick={() => agregarAlCarrito(prod)} className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl transition border-2 border-transparent hover:border-blue-500 flex flex-col justify-between h-48 text-left group">
                <span className="font-bold text-gray-800 text-2xl leading-tight group-hover:text-blue-600 transition">{prod.nombre}</span>
                <span className="text-green-600 font-black text-3xl mt-4">${prod.precio}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="w-1/3 bg-white shadow-2xl flex flex-col z-20 border-l border-gray-200">
        <div className="p-6 bg-gray-800 text-white"><h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Tu Pedido</h2></div>
        <div className="flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-4">
          {carrito.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-gray-300">
              <svg className="w-24 h-24 mb-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4M7 13L5.4 5M7 13l-2.293 2.293c-.63.63-.184 1.707.707 1.707H17m0 0a2 2 0 100 4 2 2 0 000-4zm-8 2a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"></path></svg>
              <p className="text-xl">El carrito está vacío</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            carrito.map((item, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="flex justify-between items-center bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-100">
                <div className="flex-1"><p className="font-bold text-gray-800 text-lg">{item.nombre}</p><p className="text-gray-500 font-medium">${item.precio} c/u</p></div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <button onClick={() => quitarDelCarrito(item.id)} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-red-100 text-red-600 font-bold text-xl flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-red-200 transition">-</button>
                  <span className="font-bold text-xl w-6 text-center">{item.cantidad}</span>
                  <button onClick={() => agregarAlCarrito(item)} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 font-bold text-xl flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-blue-200 transition">+</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="p-6 bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-200">
          <div className="flex justify-between text-3xl font-black mb-6 text-gray-800"><span>Total:</span><span>${calcularTotal()}</span></div>
          <button onClick={confirmarPedido} disabled={carrito.length === 0} className="w-full bg-green-600 text-white py-6 rounded-2xl text-2xl font-bold hover:bg-green-500 disabled:bg-gray-300 shadow-lg transition transform hover:scale-[1.02]">Confirmar Pedido</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
