// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\master-login\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';

export default function MasterLoginPage() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [code2FA, setCode2FA] = useState('');
  const [require2FA, setRequire2FA] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  const handleMasterLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const payload: any = { email, password };
      if (require2FA) payload.code2FA = code2FA;

      const data = await fetcher('/auth/master-login', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      if (data.require2FA) {
        setRequire2FA(true);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      if (data && data.access_token && data.user) {
        localStorage.setItem('token', data.access_token);
        localStorage.setItem('usuario', JSON.stringify(data.user));
        router.push('/super-admin');
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Credenciales inválidas.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-[#0a0a0a] relative overflow-hidden font-sans">
      <div className="absolute top-[-10%] left-[-10%] w-[40%] h-[40%] bg-[#d4af37] opacity-[0.03] blur-[120px] rounded-full"></div>
      <div className="absolute bottom-[-10%] right-[-10%] w-[40%] h-[40%] bg-[#d4af37] opacity-[0.03] blur-[120px] rounded-full"></div>

      <div className="relative z-10 bg-[#121212]/80 backdrop-blur-xl p-10 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(212,175,55,0.05)] w-full max-w-md border border-[#2a2a2a]">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <div className="mx-auto w-20 h-20 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#d4af37] to-[#8c6b1d] rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-6 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)]">
            <span className="text-4xl text-[#0a0a0a] font-serif font-bold">M</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-light text-[#f5f5f5] tracking-[0.2em] uppercase">Master Access</h1>
          <p className="text-[#d4af37] text-xs tracking-[0.3em] uppercase mt-3 font-semibold">Sistema Restringido</p>
        </div>
        
        {error && (
          <div className="bg-[#d4af37]/10 border border-[#d4af37]/30 text-[#d4af37] p-3 rounded-lg mb-6 text-sm text-center font-medium">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleMasterLogin} className="space-y-6">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-3 ml-1">Credencial Maestra</label>
            <input
              type="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[#0a0a0a] border border-[#2a2a2a] text-[#f5f5f5] p-4 rounded-xl focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#d4af37] focus:border-[#d4af37] focus:outline-none transition-all placeholder-gray-600"
              placeholder="admin@tuapp.com"
              required
              disabled={require2FA}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-3 ml-1">Clave de Encriptación</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[#0a0a0a] border border-[#2a2a2a] text-[#f5f5f5] p-4 rounded-xl focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#d4af37] focus:border-[#d4af37] focus:outline-none transition-all placeholder-gray-600 tracking-widest"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              required
              disabled={require2FA}
            />
          </div>

          {require2FA && (
            <div className="animate-fade-in">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#d4af37] uppercase tracking-widest mb-3 ml-1">Código de Seguridad (2FA)</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={code2FA}
                onChange={(e) => setCode2FA(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-[#0a0a0a] border border-[#d4af37] text-[#d4af37] p-4 rounded-xl focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#d4af37] text-center text-2xl tracking-[0.5em] font-mono shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.1)]"
                placeholder="000000"
                maxLength={6}
                required
              />
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full bg-[#d4af37] hover:bg-[#b8962e] text-[#0a0a0a] py-4 rounded-xl font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] transition-all duration-300 disabled:opacity-50 mt-4 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.2)]"
          >
            {loading ? 'Verificando...' : require2FA ? 'Validar Código' : 'Desbloquear Sistema'}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\mesas\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface Mesa { id: string; nombre: string; capacidad: number; estado: string; }
interface PedidoDetalle { id: string; cantidad: number; precioUnitario: number; producto: { nombre: string }; }
interface Pedido { id: string; total: number; createdAt: string; detalles: PedidoDetalle[]; }

export default function MesasPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [mesas, setMesas] = useState<Mesa[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [nombre, setNombre] = useState('');
  const [capacidad, setCapacidad] = useState('4');
  const [mesaSeleccionada, setMesaSeleccionada] = useState<Mesa | null>(null);
  const [pedidoDetalle, setPedidoDetalle] = useState<Pedido | null>(null);
  const [loadingDetalle, setLoadingDetalle] = useState(false);

  const sucursalActiva = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sucursalActiva') : '';

  useEffect(() => {
    cargarMesas();
  }, [sucursalActiva]);

  const cargarMesas = async () => {
    try {
      const url = sucursalActiva ? `/mesas?sucursalId=${sucursalActiva}` : '/mesas';
      const data = await fetcher(url);
      setMesas(data || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCrearMesa = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await fetcher('/mesas', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ 
          nombre, 
          capacidad: Number(capacidad),
          sucursalId: sucursalActiva || null
        })
      });
      toast.success('Mesa creada con éxito');
      setNombre(''); setCapacidad('4');
      cargarMesas();
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.message || 'Error al crear la mesa');
    }
  };

  const handleVerDetalle = async (mesa: Mesa) => {
    if (mesa.estado === 'LIBRE') return;
    setMesaSeleccionada(mesa);
    setLoadingDetalle(true);
    setPedidoDetalle(null);
    try {
      const pedido = await fetcher(`/pedidos/mesa/${mesa.id}`);
      setPedidoDetalle(pedido);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setLoadingDetalle(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center">Cargando...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800">Gestión de Mesas</h1>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">Volver al Dashboard</button>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-gray-800">Agregar Nueva Mesa</h2>
          <form onSubmit={handleCrearMesa} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <input type="text" placeholder="Ej: Mesa 1, Barra 2" required value={nombre} onChange={e => setNombre(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            <input type="number" placeholder="Capacidad (personas)" required value={capacidad} onChange={e => setCapacidad(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            <button type="submit" className="bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold p-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-700">Crear Mesa</button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {mesas.map(mesa => (
            <div 
              key={mesa.id} 
              onClick={() => handleVerDetalle(mesa)}
              className={`p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border text-center transition ${mesa.estado === 'OCUPADA' ? 'bg-red-50 border-red-200 cursor-pointer hover:shadow-md' : 'bg-white border-gray-200'}`}
            >
              <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-2">{mesa.nombre}</h3>
              <p className="text-gray-500 mb-4">Capacidad: {mesa.capacidad} pers.</p>
              <span className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold ${mesa.estado === 'LIBRE' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'}`}>{mesa.estado}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {mesaSeleccionada && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden">
            <div className="bg-gray-800 text-white p-4 flex justify-between items-center">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">Detalle: {mesaSeleccionada.nombre}</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setMesaSeleccionada(null)} className="text-gray-300 hover:text-white font-bold text-xl">&times;</button>
            </div>
            <div className="p-6">
              {loadingDetalle ? <p className="text-center text-gray-500">Cargando pedido...</p> : pedidoDetalle ? (
                <>
                  <ul className="space-y-3 mb-6">
                    {pedidoDetalle.detalles.map((det, idx) => (
                      <li key={idx} className="flex justify-between border-b pb-2">
                        <div>
                          <p className="font-semibold text-gray-800">{det.producto?.nombre}</p>
                          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">{det.cantidad} x ${det.precioUnitario}</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">${det.cantidad * Number(det.precioUnitario)}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 pt-4 border-t border-gray-300">
                    <span>Total:</span><span>${Number(pedidoDetalle.total).toFixed(2)}</span>
                  </div>
                </>
              ) : <p className="text-center text-gray-500">No hay un pedido abierto en esta mesa.</p>}
            </div>
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 flex justify-end">
              <button onClick={() => setMesaSeleccionada(null)} className="bg-gray-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded hover:bg-gray-600">Cerrar</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\pos\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { usePOS } from './hooks/usePOS';
import Catalog from './components/Catalog';
import Cart from './components/Cart';
import ModifierModal from './components/ModifierModal';
import PaymentModal from './components/PaymentModal';
import TicketModal from '../../components/TicketModal';

export default function POSPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { state, actions } = usePOS();

  const calcularTotalCarrito = () => {
    return state.carrito.reduce((total, item) => total + (item.precio * item.cantidad), 0);
  };

  const handleAbrirCobro = () => {
    if (state.carrito.length === 0 && state.mesaActivaId) {
      actions.liberarMesaVacia();
    } else {
      actions.setModalPagoAbierto(true);
    }
  };

  if (state.loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center text-xl">Cargando catálogo...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen bg-gray-100">
      
      {/* PANEL IZQUIERDO: CATÁLOGO */}
      <Catalog 
        categorias={state.categorias}
        productos={state.productos}
        categoriaActiva={state.categoriaActiva}
        onCategoriaChange={actions.setCategoriaActiva}
        onProductoClick={actions.handleProductoClick}
      />

      {/* PANEL DERECHO: TICKET */}
      <Cart 
        carrito={state.carrito}
        mesas={state.mesas}
        clientes={state.clientes}
        mesaActivaId={state.mesaActivaId}
        clienteActivoId={state.clienteActivoId}
        total={calcularTotalCarrito()}
        onMesaChange={actions.handleMesaChange}
        onClienteChange={actions.setClienteActivoId}
        onGuardar={actions.guardarMesa}
        onCobrar={handleAbrirCobro}
      />

      {/* MODALES */}
      <ModifierModal 
        producto={state.productoModificando}
        modificadores={state.modificadoresDisponibles}
        seleccionados={state.modificadoresSeleccionados}
        onToggle={(mod) => {
          const existe = state.modificadoresSeleccionados.find(m => m.id === mod.id);
          if (existe) actions.setModificadoresSeleccionados(state.modificadoresSeleccionados.filter(m => m.id !== mod.id));
          else actions.setModificadoresSeleccionados([...state.modificadoresSeleccionados, mod]);
        }}
        onConfirm={actions.confirmarModificadores}
        onClose={() => actions.setProductoModificando(null)}
      />

      <PaymentModal 
        isOpen={state.modalPagoAbierto}
        total={calcularTotalCarrito()}
        onClose={() => actions.setModalPagoAbierto(false)}
        onConfirm={actions.procesarPago}
      />

      <TicketModal 
        isOpen={!!state.ventaExitosa} 
        onClose={() => actions.setVentaExitosa(null)} 
        venta={state.ventaExitosa} 
      />

    </div>
  );
}

// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\pos\components\Cart.tsx
// ===================================================================
import { Mesa, Cliente, ItemCarrito } from '../hooks/usePOS';

interface Props {
  carrito: ItemCarrito[];
  mesas: Mesa[];
  clientes: Cliente[];
  mesaActivaId: string;
  clienteActivoId: string;
  total: number;
  onMesaChange: (id: string) => void;
  onClienteChange: (id: string) => void;
  onGuardar: () => void;
  onCobrar: () => void;
}

export default function Cart({ carrito, mesas, clientes, mesaActivaId, clienteActivoId, total, onMesaChange, onClienteChange, onGuardar, onCobrar }: Props) {
  return (
    <div className="w-1/3 bg-white shadow-xl flex flex-col">
      <div className="p-4 bg-gray-800 text-white flex flex-col gap-2">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">Ticket Actual</h2>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <select value={mesaActivaId} onChange={e => onMesaChange(e.target.value)} className="w-1/2 bg-gray-700 text-white p-1 rounded text-sm">
            <option value="">Mostrador</option>
            {mesas.map(m => <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.nombre} {m.estado === 'OCUPADA' ? '(Ocupada)' : ''}</option>)}
          </select>
          <select value={clienteActivoId} onChange={e => onClienteChange(e.target.value)} className="w-1/2 bg-gray-700 text-white p-1 rounded text-sm">
            <option value="">Consumidor Final</option>
            {clientes.map(c => <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.nombre}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1 p-4 overflow-y-auto">
        {carrito.length === 0 ? <p className="text-gray-400 text-center mt-10">No hay productos</p> : (
          <ul className="space-y-3">
            {carrito.map((item, i) => (
              <li key={i} className="flex justify-between border-b pb-2">
                <div>
                  <p className="font-semibold text-gray-800">{item.nombre}</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">{item.cantidad} x ${item.precio}</p>
                  {item.notas && <p className="text-xs text-blue-600">({item.notas})</p>}
                </div>
                <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">${item.precio * item.cantidad}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="p-4 bg-gray-50 border-t">
        <div className="flex justify-between text-2xl font-bold mb-4 text-gray-800"><span>Total:</span><span>${total}</span></div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button onClick={onGuardar} disabled={carrito.length === 0} className="w-1/2 bg-yellow-500 text-white py-3 rounded font-bold hover:bg-yellow-600 disabled:bg-gray-300">Guardar Mesa</button>
          <button onClick={onCobrar} disabled={carrito.length === 0 && !mesaActivaId} className="w-1/2 bg-green-600 text-white py-3 rounded font-bold hover:bg-green-700 disabled:bg-gray-300">{carrito.length === 0 && mesaActivaId ? 'Liberar' : 'Cobrar'}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Categoria, Producto } from '../hooks/usePOS';

interface Props {
  categorias: Categoria[];
  productos: Producto[];
  categoriaActiva: string;
  onCategoriaChange: (id: string) => void;
  onProductoClick: (p: Producto) => void;
}

export default function Catalog({ categorias, productos, categoriaActiva, onCategoriaChange, onProductoClick }: Props) {
  const filtrados = categoriaActiva === 'ALL' ? productos : productos.filter(p => p.categoriaId === categoriaActiva);

  return (
    <div className="w-2/3 flex flex-col border-r border-gray-300">
      <div className="bg-white p-4 shadow-sm flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto">
        <button onClick={() => onCategoriaChange('ALL')} className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full font-bold ${categoriaActiva === 'ALL' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'}`}>Todos</button>
        {categorias.map(cat => (
          <button key={cat.id} onClick={() => onCategoriaChange(cat.id)} className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full font-bold ${categoriaActiva === cat.id ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'}`}>{cat.nombre}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {filtrados.map(prod => (
            <button key={prod.id} onClick={() => onProductoClick(prod)} className="p-4 rounded-lg shadow border bg-white hover:shadow-lg flex flex-col justify-between h-32">
              <span className="font-bold text-gray-800 text-lg">{prod.nombre}</span>
              <span className="text-green-600 font-bold self-end text-xl">${prod.precio}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface Props {

  modificadores: Modificador[];
  seleccionados: Modificador[];
  onToggle: (mod: Modificador) => void;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function ModifierModal({ producto, modificadores, seleccionados, onToggle, onConfirm, onClose }: Props) {
  if (!producto) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-60 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden">
        <div className="bg-blue-600 text-white p-4">
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">Opciones para: {producto.nombre}</h3>
        </div>
        <div className="p-6 space-y-3 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
          {modificadores.map(mod => (

                  type="checkbox" 
                  checked={seleccionados.some(m => m.id === mod.id)}
                  onChange={() => onToggle(mod)}
                  className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 rounded"
                />
                <span className="font-medium text-gray-800">{mod.nombre}</span>
              </div>

              </span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-gray-50 border-t flex gap-3">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="w-1/2 bg-gray-300 text-gray-800 font-bold py-2 rounded hover:bg-gray-400">Cancelar</button>
          <button onClick={onConfirm} className="w-1/2 bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold py-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-700">Agregar al Ticket</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\pos\components\PaymentModal.tsx
// ===================================================================
import { useState } from 'react';

interface Props {
  isOpen: boolean;
  total: number;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: (datosPago: any) => void;
}

export default function PaymentModal({ isOpen, total, onClose, onConfirm }: Props) {
  const [metodoPago, setMetodoPago] = useState<'EFECTIVO' | 'TARJETA' | 'TRANSFERENCIA'>('EFECTIVO');
  const [montoRecibido, setMontoRecibido] = useState('');
  const [esDelivery, setEsDelivery] = useState(false);
  const [direccion, setDireccion] = useState('');
  const [costoEnvio, setCostoEnvio] = useState('0');
  const [tipoFactura, setTipoFactura] = useState<'FACTURA_A' | 'FACTURA_B' | 'FACTURA_C'>('FACTURA_B');
  const [cuit, setCuit] = useState('');
  const [razonSocial, setRazonSocial] = useState('');

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const totalFinal = total + (esDelivery ? Number(costoEnvio) : 0);
  const vuelto = Number(montoRecibido) - totalFinal;

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    if (metodoPago === 'EFECTIVO' && Number(montoRecibido) < totalFinal) {
      alert('El monto recibido es menor al total a pagar.');
      return;
    }
    if (esDelivery && !direccion) {
      alert('Por favor, ingresá la dirección de entrega.');
      return;
    }

    let cuitLimpio = null;
    if (tipoFactura !== 'FACTURA_B') {
      cuitLimpio = cuit.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''); // Solo números
      if (cuitLimpio.length !== 11) {
        alert('El CUIT debe tener exactamente 11 dígitos numéricos.');
        return;
      }
    }

    onConfirm({
      metodoPago,
      direccionEntrega: esDelivery ? direccion : null,
      costoEnvio: esDelivery ? Number(costoEnvio) : 0,
      tipoFactura,
      cuitFactura: tipoFactura !== 'FACTURA_B' ? cuitLimpio : null,
      razonSocialFactura: tipoFactura !== 'FACTURA_B' ? razonSocial : null,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-60 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
        <div className="bg-green-600 text-white p-4 text-center">
          <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold">Cobrar Ticket</h3>
          <p className="text-3xl font-light mt-2">Total: ${totalFinal}</p>
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-6 space-y-5 overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 p-4 rounded-lg">
            <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">Comprobante Fiscal</label>
            <select value={tipoFactura} onChange={e => setTipoFactura(e.target.value as any)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800 font-medium mb-3">
              <option value="FACTURA_B">Factura B (Consumidor Final)</option>
              <option value="FACTURA_A">Factura A (Responsable Inscripto)</option>
              <option value="FACTURA_C">Factura C (Monotributista)</option>
            </select>
            {tipoFactura !== 'FACTURA_B' && (
              <div className="space-y-3 mt-3">
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  placeholder="CUIT (11 dígitos)" 
                  value={cuit} 
                  onChange={e => setCuit(e.target.value)} 
                  maxLength={13}
                  className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" 
                />
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  placeholder="Razón Social" 
                  value={razonSocial} 
                  onChange={e => setRazonSocial(e.target.value)} 
                  className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" 
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="bg-orange-50 border border-orange-200 p-4 rounded-lg">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={esDelivery} onChange={(e) => setEsDelivery(e.target.checked)} className="w-6 h-6 text-orange-600 rounded" />
              <span className="font-bold text-orange-800 text-lg">Es Delivery</span>
            </label>
            {esDelivery && (
              <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                <input type="text" value={direccion} onChange={e => setDireccion(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" placeholder="Dirección de entrega..." />
                <input type="number" value={costoEnvio} onChange={e => setCostoEnvio(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" placeholder="Costo de envío" />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">Método de Pago</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <button onClick={() => setMetodoPago('EFECTIVO')} className={`py-2 rounded border font-bold ${metodoPago === 'EFECTIVO' ? 'bg-green-100 border-green-500 text-green-700' : 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-600'}`}>Efectivo</button>
              <button onClick={() => setMetodoPago('TARJETA')} className={`py-2 rounded border font-bold ${metodoPago === 'TARJETA' ? 'bg-blue-100 border-blue-500 text-blue-700' : 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-600'}`}>Tarjeta</button>
              <button onClick={() => setMetodoPago('TRANSFERENCIA')} className={`py-2 rounded border font-bold ${metodoPago === 'TRANSFERENCIA' ? 'bg-purple-100 border-purple-500 text-purple-700' : 'bg-gray-50 text-gray-600'}`}>QR / Transf.</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {metodoPago === 'EFECTIVO' && (
            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 space-y-3">
              <input type="number" value={montoRecibido} onChange={e => setMontoRecibido(e.target.value)} className="w-full text-2xl border p-3 rounded text-gray-800 font-bold" placeholder="Monto recibido" autoFocus />
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-lg font-bold">
                <span className="text-gray-600">Vuelto:</span>
                <span className={vuelto >= 0 ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-600'}>${vuelto > 0 ? vuelto.toFixed(2) : '0.00'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        
        <div className="p-4 bg-gray-50 border-t flex gap-3">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="w-1/2 bg-gray-200 text-gray-800 font-bold py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300">Cancelar</button>
          <button onClick={handleConfirm} className="w-1/2 bg-green-600 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700">Confirmar Pago</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\pos\hooks\usePOS.ts
// ===================================================================
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { fetcher } from '../../../lib/api';
import { useAuth } from '../../../context/AuthContext';

export interface Categoria { id: string; nombre: string; }
export interface Mesa { id: string; nombre: string; estado: string; }
export interface Cliente { id: string; nombre: string; }
export interface Modificador { id: string; nombre: string; precioExtra: number; }
export interface Producto { id: string; nombre: string; precio: number; stock: number; categoriaId?: string; }
export interface ItemCarrito extends Producto { cantidad: number; notas?: string; }

export function usePOS() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  
  // Usamos la sucursal del usuario autenticado (viene del backend), no del localStorage
  const sucursalActiva = user?.sucursalId || '';

  const [productos, setProductos] = useState<Producto[]>([]);
  const [categorias, setCategorias] = useState<Categoria[]>([]);
  const [mesas, setMesas] = useState<Mesa[]>([]);
  const [clientes, setClientes] = useState<Cliente[]>([]);
  const [carrito, setCarrito] = useState<ItemCarrito[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [mesaActivaId, setMesaActivaId] = useState<string>('');
  const [clienteActivoId, setClienteActivoId] = useState<string>('');
  const [pedidoActualId, setPedidoActualId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [categoriaActiva, setCategoriaActiva] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const [productoModificando, setProductoModificando] = useState<Producto | null>(null);
  const [modificadoresDisponibles, setModificadoresDisponibles] = useState<Modificador[]>([]);
  const [modificadoresSeleccionados, setModificadoresSeleccionados] = useState<Modificador[]>([]);
  const [modalPagoAbierto, setModalPagoAbierto] = useState(false);
  const [ventaExitosa, setVentaExitosa] = useState<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Si no hay usuario, no cargar nada (el AuthContext redirige)
    if (!user) return;

    const cargarDatos = async () => {
      try {
        const urlMesas = sucursalActiva ? `/mesas?sucursalId=${sucursalActiva}` : '/mesas';
        const [prods, cats, mess, clis] = await Promise.all([
          fetcher('/productos'),
          fetcher('/categorias'),
          fetcher(urlMesas),
          fetcher('/clientes')
        ]);
        setProductos(prods || []);
        setCategorias(cats || []);
        setMesas(mess || []);
        setClientes(clis || []);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    cargarDatos();
  }, [sucursalActiva, user]);

  const handleMesaChange = async (nuevaMesaId: string) => {
    setMesaActivaId(nuevaMesaId);
    setCarrito([]);
    setPedidoActualId(null);
    if (!nuevaMesaId) return;

    try {
      const pedidoAbierto = await fetcher(`/pedidos/mesa/${nuevaMesaId}`);
      if (pedidoAbierto && pedidoAbierto.id) {
        setPedidoActualId(pedidoAbierto.id);
        setCarrito(pedidoAbierto.detalles.map((det: any) => ({
          id: det.producto.id, nombre: det.producto.nombre, precio: Number(det.precioUnitario),
          cantidad: Number(det.cantidad), stock: 999, notas: det.notas
        })));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    }
  };

  const handleProductoClick = async (producto: Producto) => {
    try {
      const mods = await fetcher(`/modificadores/producto/${producto.id}`);
      if (mods && mods.length > 0) {
        setProductoModificando(producto);
        setModificadoresDisponibles(mods);
        setModificadoresSeleccionados([]);
      } else {
        agregarAlCarrito(producto, producto.precio, '');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      agregarAlCarrito(producto, producto.precio, '');
    }
  };

  const agregarAlCarrito = (producto: Producto, precioFinal: number, notas: string) => {
    setCarrito(prev => {
      const existeIndex = prev.findIndex(item => item.id === producto.id && item.notas === notas);
      if (existeIndex >= 0) {
        const nuevoCarrito = [...prev];
        nuevoCarrito[existeIndex].cantidad += 1;
        return nuevoCarrito;
      }
      return [...prev, { ...producto, precio: precioFinal, cantidad: 1, notas }];
    });
  };

  const confirmarModificadores = () => {
    if (!productoModificando) return;
    const extra = modificadoresSeleccionados.reduce((acc, mod) => acc + Number(mod.precioExtra), 0);
    agregarAlCarrito(productoModificando, Number(productoModificando.precio) + extra, modificadoresSeleccionados.map(m => m.nombre).join(', '));
    setProductoModificando(null);
  };

  const liberarMesaVacia = async () => {
    try {
      if (pedidoActualId) {
        // CORREGIDO: Usamos anular, no PATCH estado. El DTO restringido ya no acepta estado.
        await fetcher(`/pedidos/${pedidoActualId}/anular`, { 
          method: 'PATCH', 
          body: JSON.stringify({ motivo: 'Mesa liberada sin consumo' }) 
        });
      }
      await fetcher(`/mesas/${mesaActivaId}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ estado: 'LIBRE' }) });
      setMesaActivaId(''); setPedidoActualId(null);
      
      const urlMesas = sucursalActiva ? `/mesas?sucursalId=${sucursalActiva}` : '/mesas';
      setMesas(await fetcher(urlMesas) || []);
    } catch (error) { 
      console.error(error); 
    }
  };

  const procesarPago = async (datosPago: any) => {
    const pedidoData = {
      pedidoId: pedidoActualId,
      estado: 'PAGADO',
      sucursalId: sucursalActiva || null,
      ...datosPago,
      detalles: carrito.map(item => ({ productoId: item.id, cantidad: item.cantidad, notas: item.notas }))
    };

    try {
      const ventaData = await fetcher('/pedidos', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(pedidoData) });
      setVentaExitosa(ventaData);
      setCarrito([]); setMesaActivaId(''); setClienteActivoId(''); setPedidoActualId(null); setModalPagoAbierto(false);
      
      const urlMesas = sucursalActiva ? `/mesas?sucursalId=${sucursalActiva}` : '/mesas';
      const [prods, mess] = await Promise.all([ fetcher('/productos'), fetcher(urlMesas) ]);
      setProductos(prods || []);
      setMesas(mess || []);
    } catch (error: any) { alert(`Error: ${error.message}`); }
  };

  const guardarMesa = async () => {
    const pedidoData = {
      pedidoId: pedidoActualId,
      estado: 'ABIERTO',
      mesaId: mesaActivaId || null,
      clienteId: clienteActivoId || null,
      sucursalId: sucursalActiva || null,
      detalles: carrito.map(item => ({ productoId: item.id, cantidad: item.cantidad, notas: item.notas }))
    };
    try {
      await fetcher('/pedidos', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(pedidoData) });
      alert('Mesa guardada correctamente');
      setCarrito([]); setMesaActivaId(''); setClienteActivoId(''); setPedidoActualId(null);
      
      const urlMesas = sucursalActiva ? `/mesas?sucursalId=${sucursalActiva}` : '/mesas';
      const [prods, mess] = await Promise.all([ fetcher('/productos'), fetcher(urlMesas) ]);
      setProductos(prods || []);
      setMesas(mess || []);
    } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
  };

  return {
    state: { productos, categorias, mesas, clientes, carrito, loading, mesaActivaId, clienteActivoId, categoriaActiva, productoModificando, modificadoresDisponibles, modificadoresSeleccionados, modalPagoAbierto, ventaExitosa },
    actions: { setClienteActivoId, setCategoriaActiva, setModalPagoAbierto, setVentaExitosa, setProductoModificando, setModificadoresSeleccionados, handleMesaChange, handleProductoClick, confirmarModificadores, liberarMesaVacia, procesarPago, guardarMesa }
  };
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\productos\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';

interface Categoria { id: string; nombre: string; }
interface Producto { id: string; nombre: string; precio: number; costo: number; stock: number; categoria?: Categoria; }
interface Insumo { id: string; nombre: string; unidadMedida: string; }
interface RecetaItem { id: string; cantidad: number; insumo: Insumo; }

export default function ProductosPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [productos, setProductos] = useState<Producto[]>([]);
  const [categorias, setCategorias] = useState<Categoria[]>([]);
  const [insumos, setInsumos] = useState<Insumo[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  const [nombre, setNombre] = useState('');
  const [precio, setPrecio] = useState('');
  const [costo, setCosto] = useState('');
  const [stock, setStock] = useState('');
  const [categoriaId, setCategoriaId] = useState('');

  const [productoReceta, setProductoReceta] = useState<Producto | null>(null);
  const [recetaActual, setRecetaActual] = useState<RecetaItem[]>([]);
  const [nuevoInsumoId, setNuevoInsumoId] = useState('');
  const [nuevaCantidad, setNuevaCantidad] = useState('1');

  // Función movida arriba del useEffect
  const cargarDatos = async () => {
    try {
      const [prods, cats, inss] = await Promise.all([
        fetcher('/productos'),
        fetcher('/categorias'),
        fetcher('/insumos')
      ]);
      setProductos(prods || []);
      setCategorias(cats || []);
      setInsumos(inss || []);
      if (cats && cats.length > 0) setCategoriaId(cats[0].id);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { 
    cargarDatos(); 
  }, []);

  const handleCrearCategoria = async () => {
    const nombreCat = prompt('Ingrese el nombre de la nueva categoría:');
    if (!nombreCat) return;
    try {
      await fetcher('/categorias', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ nombre: nombreCat }) });
      toast.success('Categoría creada');
      cargarDatos();
    } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
  };

  const handleCrearProducto = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await fetcher('/productos', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ nombre, precio: Number(precio), costo: Number(costo), stock: Number(stock), categoriaId: categoriaId || null })
      });
      toast.success('Producto creado con éxito');
      setNombre(''); setPrecio(''); setCosto(''); setStock('');
      cargarDatos();
    } catch (error: unknown) { 
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Error al crear el producto'); 
    }
  };

  const abrirModalReceta = async (prod: Producto) => {
    setProductoReceta(prod);
    try {
      const data = await fetcher(`/recetas/producto/${prod.id}`);
      setRecetaActual(data || []);
    } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
  };

  const handleAgregarInsumo = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!productoReceta || !nuevoInsumoId) return;
    try {
      await fetcher('/recetas', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ productoId: productoReceta.id, insumoId: nuevoInsumoId, cantidad: Number(nuevaCantidad) })
      });
      const resRec = await fetcher(`/recetas/producto/${productoReceta.id}`);
      setRecetaActual(resRec || []);
      setNuevaCantidad('1');
    } catch (error: unknown) { 
      toast.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Error al agregar insumo'); 
    }
  };

  const handleEliminarInsumo = async (recetaId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('¿Quitar este insumo de la receta?')) return;
    try {
      await fetcher(`/recetas/${recetaId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      if (productoReceta) {
        const resRec = await fetcher(`/recetas/producto/${productoReceta.id}`);
        setRecetaActual(resRec || []);
      }
    } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center">Cargando...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800">Gestión de Productos</h1>
          <div className="flex gap-4">
            <button onClick={handleCrearCategoria} className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold">+ Nueva Categoría</button>
            <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline py-2">Volver al Dashboard</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-gray-800">Agregar Nuevo Producto</h2>
          <form onSubmit={handleCrearProducto} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-6 gap-4">
            <input type="text" placeholder="Nombre" required value={nombre} onChange={e => setNombre(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            <select value={categoriaId} onChange={e => setCategoriaId(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800">
              <option value="">Sin Categoría</option>
              {categorias.map(cat => <option key={cat.id} value={cat.id}>{cat.nombre}</option>)}
            </select>
            <input type="number" placeholder="Precio Venta" required value={precio} onChange={e => setPrecio(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            <input type="number" placeholder="Costo" required value={costo} onChange={e => setCosto(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            <input type="number" placeholder="Stock Inicial" required value={stock} onChange={e => setStock(e.target.value)} className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            <button type="submit" className="bg-green-600 text-white font-bold p-2 rounded hover:bg-green-700">Guardar</button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-b">
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Producto</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Categoría</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Stock</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold text-center">Receta</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {productos.map(prod => (
                <tr key={prod.id} className="border-b hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-800">
                  <td className="p-4 font-medium">{prod.nombre}</td>
                  <td className="p-4">
                    <span className="bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold">{prod.categoria?.nombre || 'General'}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4"><span className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold ${prod.stock > 5 ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'}`}>{prod.stock} un.</span></td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-center">
                    <button onClick={() => abrirModalReceta(prod)} className="bg-teal-100 text-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-200 px-3 py-1 rounded font-bold text-sm transition">Gestionar Insumos</button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {productoReceta && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="bg-teal-700 text-white p-4 flex justify-between items-center">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">Receta: {productoReceta.nombre}</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setProductoReceta(null)} className="text-teal-200 hover:text-white font-bold text-2xl">&times;</button>
            </div>
            <div className="p-6">
              <form onSubmit={handleAgregarInsumo} className="flex gap-2 mb-6 items-end">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Insumo</label>
                  <select value={nuevoInsumoId} onChange={e => setNuevoInsumoId(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" required>
                    <option value="">Seleccione un insumo...</option>
                    {insumos.map(ins => <option key={ins.id} value={ins.id}>{ins.nombre} ({ins.unidadMedida})</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="w-24">
                  <label className="block text-sm text-gray-600 mb-1">Cantidad</label>
                  <input type="number" step="0.01" required value={nuevaCantidad} onChange={e => setNuevaCantidad(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
                </div>
                <button type="submit" className="bg-teal-600 text-white font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded hover:bg-teal-700 h-[42px]">Agregar</button>
              </form>

              <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">Insumos actuales:</h4>
              {recetaActual.length === 0 ? <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm italic bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded text-center">Este producto todavía no tiene insumos asignados.</p> : (
                <ul className="space-y-2">
                  {recetaActual.map(item => (
                    <li key={item.id} className="flex justify-between items-center bg-gray-50 border p-3 rounded">
                      <span className="font-medium text-gray-800">{item.insumo?.nombre || 'Insumo no encontrado'}</span>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <span className="text-sm text-gray-600">{item.cantidad} {item.insumo?.unidadMedida.toLowerCase() || 'un.'}</span>
                        <button onClick={() => handleEliminarInsumo(item.id)} className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 font-bold">&times;</button>
                      </div>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

  const [telefono, setTelefono] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [direccion, setDireccion] = useState('');

      const data = await fetcher('/proveedores');
      setProveedores(data || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCrearProveedor = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {

      });

                    {prov.email && <div>✉️ {prov.email}</div>}
                  </td>

              ))}
              {proveedores.length === 0 && <tr><td colSpan={3} className="p-4 text-center text-gray-500">No hay proveedores cargados</td></tr>}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\reservas\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { fetcher } from '../../lib/api';

interface Cliente { id: string; nombre: string; }
interface Mesa { id: string; nombre: string; capacidad: number; }
interface Reserva { id: string; fechaHora: string; cantidadPersonas: number; estado: string; mesa: Mesa; cliente: Cliente; }

export default function ReservasPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [reservas, setReservas] = useState<Reserva[]>([]);
  const [clientes, setClientes] = useState<Cliente[]>([]);
  const [mesas, setMesas] = useState<Mesa[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [fechaHora, setFechaHora] = useState('');
  const [cantidadPersonas, setCantidadPersonas] = useState('2');
  const [mesaId, setMesaId] = useState('');
  const [clienteId, setClienteId] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => { cargarDatos(); }, []);

  const cargarDatos = async () => {
    try {
      const [resRes, resCli, resMes] = await Promise.all([fetcher('/reservas'), fetcher('/clientes'), fetcher('/mesas')]);
      setReservas(resRes || []);
      setClientes(resCli || []);
      setMesas(resMes || []);
      if (resCli && resCli.length > 0) setClienteId(resCli[0].id);
      if (resMes && resMes.length > 0) setMesaId(resMes[0].id);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCrearReserva = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!fechaHora || !mesaId || !clienteId) return toast.error('Completá todos los campos');
    try {
      await fetcher('/reservas', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ fechaHora: new Date(fechaHora).toISOString(), cantidadPersonas: Number(cantidadPersonas), mesaId, clienteId })
      });
      toast.success('Reserva creada con éxito');
      setFechaHora(''); setCantidadPersonas('2');
      cargarDatos();
    } catch (error: any) { toast.error(error.message || 'Error al crear la reserva'); }
  };

  const handleCancelarReserva = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('¿Estás seguro de cancelar esta reserva?')) return;
    try {
      await fetcher(`/reservas/${id}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ estado: 'CANCELADA' }) });
      cargarDatos();
    } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center">Cargando reservas...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800">Libro de Reservas</h1>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">Volver al Dashboard</button>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-gray-800">Nueva Reserva</h2>
          <form onSubmit={handleCrearReserva} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Fecha y Hora</label>
              <input type="datetime-local" required value={fechaHora} onChange={e => setFechaHora(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Cliente</label>
              <select value={clienteId} onChange={e => setClienteId(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800">
                {clientes.map(c => <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.nombre}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Mesa</label>
              <select value={mesaId} onChange={e => setMesaId(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800">
                {mesas.map(m => <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.nombre} (Cap: {m.capacidad})</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">Personas</label>
              <input type="number" required value={cantidadPersonas} onChange={e => setCantidadPersonas(e.target.value)} className="w-full border p-2 rounded text-gray-800" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-end">
              <button type="submit" className="w-full bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold p-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-700 h-[42px]">Reservar</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-b">
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Fecha / Hora</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Cliente</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Mesa</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Personas</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Estado</th>
                <th className="p-4 font-semibold text-center">Acciones</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {reservas.map(res => (
                <tr key={res.id} className="border-b hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-800">
                  <td className="p-4 font-medium">{new Date(res.fechaHora).toLocaleString('es-AR', { dateStyle: 'short', timeStyle: 'short' })}</td>
                  <td className="p-4">{res.cliente?.nombre}</td>
                  <td className="p-4"><span className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold">{res.mesa?.nombre}</span></td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-center">{res.cantidadPersonas}</td>
                  <td className="p-4">
                    <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-bold ${res.estado === 'PENDIENTE' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700' : res.estado === 'CUMPLIDA' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-700' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-700'}`}>{res.estado}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-center">
                    {res.estado === 'PENDIENTE' && <button onClick={() => handleCancelarReserva(res.id)} className="text-red-500 hover:underline text-sm font-bold">Cancelar</button>}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {reservas.length === 0 && <tr><td colSpan={6} className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500">No hay reservas registradas.</td></tr>}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\sucursales\page.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

interface Sucursal {
  id: string;
  nombre: string;
  direccion: string;
}

export default function SucursalesPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [sucursales, setSucursales] = useState<Sucursal[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  const [nombre, setNombre] = useState('');
  const [direccion, setDireccion] = useState('');

  const token = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('token') : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!token) {
      router.push('/');
      return;
    }
    cargarSucursales();
  }, [router, token]);

  const cargarSucursales = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/sucursales', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
      const data = await res.json();
      setSucursales(data);
      setLoading(false);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCrearSucursal = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/sucursales', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
        body: JSON.stringify({ nombre, direccion })
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        alert('Sucursal creada con éxito');
        setNombre(''); setDireccion('');
        cargarSucursales();
      } else {
        alert('Error al crear la sucursal');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center">Cargando...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-8">
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800">Gestión de Sucursales</h1>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')} className="text-blue-600 hover:underline">
            Volver al Dashboard
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-gray-800">Agregar Nueva Sucursal</h2>
          <form onSubmit={handleCrearSucursal} className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <input
              type="text" placeholder="Nombre (Ej: Local Centro)" required value={nombre} onChange={e => setNombre(e.target.value)}
              className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800"
            />
            <input
              type="text" placeholder="Dirección" required value={direccion} onChange={e => setDireccion(e.target.value)}
              className="border p-2 rounded text-gray-800"
            />
            <button type="submit" className="bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold p-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-700">
              Crear Sucursal
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {sucursales.map(suc => (
            <div key={suc.id} className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-2">{suc.nombre}</h3>
              <p className="text-gray-500">{suc.direccion}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
          {sucursales.length === 0 && (
            <div className="col-span-full text-center text-gray-500 py-10">
              No hay sucursales creadas aún.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

            Partners

          >
            <svg className="w-5 h-5 mr-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1.5} d="M10.325 4.317c.426-1.756 2.924-1.756 3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 002.573 1.066c1.543-.94 3.31.826 2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 001.065 2.572c1.756.426 1.756 2.924 0 3.35a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.066 2.573c.94 1.543-.826 3.31-2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.572 1.065c-.426 1.756-2.924 1.756-3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.573-1.066c-1.543.94-3.31-.826-2.37-2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.065-2.572c-1.756-.426-1.756-2.924 0-3.35a1.724 1.724 0 001.066-2.573c-.94-1.543.826-3.31 2.37-2.37.996.608 2.296.07 2.572-1.065z" /><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1.5} d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" /></svg>
            Configuración
          </button>
        </nav>

        <div className="p-4 border-t border-[#2a2a2a]">
          <button 
            onClick={handleLogout}
            className="w-full flex items-center px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/10 transition-all"
          >
            <svg className="w-5 h-5 mr-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1.5} d="M17 16l4-4m0 0l-4-4m4 4H7m6 4v1a3 3 0 01-3 3H6a3 3 0 01-3-3V7a3 3 0 013-3h4a3 3 0 013 3v1" /></svg>
            DESCONECTAR
          </button>
        </div>
      </aside>

      <main className="flex-1 flex flex-col h-screen overflow-hidden bg-[#0a0a0a]">
        {renderContent()}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}


// ===================================================================
// ARCHIVO: \frontend\app\super-admin\components\ClientesView.tsx
// ===================================================================
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { fetcher } from '../../../lib/api';
import ModalCrearCliente from './ModalCrearCliente';

interface Empresa { id: string; nombre: string; cuit: string; activa: boolean; usuarios: number; totalVentas: number; fechaAlta: string; plan?: string; }
interface Plan { id: string; nombre: string; precioMensual: number; }

export default function ClientesView({ searchQuery = '' }: { searchQuery?: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [empresas, setEmpresas] = useState<Empresa[]>([]);
  const [planes, setPlanes] = useState<Plan[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [filtroEstado, setFiltroEstado] = useState('TODOS');
  const [modalAbierto, setModalAbierto] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => { cargarDatos(); }, []);

  const cargarDatos = async () => {
    try {
      const [resEmp, resPlanes] = await Promise.all([
        fetcher('/super-admin/empresas'),
        fetcher('/planes')
      ]);
      if (resEmp) setEmpresas(resEmp);
      if (resPlanes) setPlanes(resPlanes);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleEstado = async (id: string, estadoActual: boolean) => {
    const accion = estadoActual ? 'SUSPENDER' : 'ACTIVAR';
    if (!confirm(`¿Estás seguro de ${accion} esta empresa?`)) return;
    try {
      await fetcher(`/super-admin/empresas/${id}/toggle`, { method: 'PATCH' });
      toast.success(`Empresa ${estadoActual ? 'suspendida' : 'activada'}`);
      cargarDatos();
    } catch (error: any) { toast.error(error.message || 'Error al cambiar estado'); }
  };

  const handleImpersonar = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('¿Entrar como soporte a esta empresa?')) return;
    try {
      const data = await fetcher(`/super-admin/empresas/${id}/impersonar`, { method: 'POST' });
      if (data) {
        localStorage.setItem('token', data.access_token);
        localStorage.setItem('usuario', JSON.stringify(data.usuario));
        localStorage.removeItem('sucursalActiva');
        router.push('/dashboard');
      }
    } catch (error: any) { toast.error(error.message || 'Error al impersonar'); }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="text-[#D4AF37] animate-pulse">Cargando clientes...</div>;

  const empresasFiltradas = empresas.filter(e => {
    const coincideNombre = e.nombre.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) || e.cuit.includes(searchQuery);
    const coincideEstado = filtroEstado === 'TODOS' ? true : filtroEstado === 'ACTIVAS' ? e.activa : !e.activa;
    return coincideNombre && coincideEstado;
  });

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#0a0a0a] rounded-xl border border-gray-800 shadow-xl overflow-hidden">
      <div className="p-6 border-b border-gray-800 flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-light text-white uppercase tracking-widest">
            Directorio de Empresas {searchQuery && `(Filtrado: ${searchQuery})`}
          </h2>
          <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4">
            <button onClick={() => setFiltroEstado('TODOS')} className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded ${filtroEstado === 'TODOS' ? 'bg-gray-700 text-white' : 'bg-[#111] text-gray-500 hover:text-white'}`}>TODAS</button>
            <button onClick={() => setFiltroEstado('ACTIVAS')} className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded ${filtroEstado === 'ACTIVAS' ? 'bg-green-900/50 text-green-400 border border-green-900' : 'bg-[#111] text-gray-500 hover:text-green-400'}`}>ACTIVAS</button>
            <button onClick={() => setFiltroEstado('SUSPENDIDAS')} className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded ${filtroEstado === 'SUSPENDIDAS' ? 'bg-red-900/50 text-red-400 border border-red-900' : 'bg-[#111] text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400'}`}>SUSPENDIDAS</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button onClick={() => setModalAbierto(true)} className="bg-[#111] border border-[#D4AF37]/50 text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37] hover:text-black font-bold py-2 px-6 rounded transition-all text-xs uppercase tracking-widest">
          + Nueva Empresa
        </button>
      </div>
      
      <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
        <thead>
          <tr className="bg-black/50 text-gray-500 text-xs border-b border-gray-800 uppercase tracking-wider">
            <th className="p-4 font-medium">Empresa / CUIT</th>
            <th className="p-4 font-medium text-center">Plan</th>
            <th className="p-4 font-medium text-center">Usuarios</th>
            <th className="p-4 font-medium text-right">Ventas</th>
            <th className="p-4 font-medium text-center">Estado</th>
            <th className="p-4 font-medium text-center">Acciones</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {empresasFiltradas.map(emp => (
            <tr key={emp.id} className="border-b border-gray-800/50 hover:bg-[#111] transition-colors">
              <td className="p-4">
                <p className="font-medium text-gray-200 text-base">{emp.nombre}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-600">{emp.cuit}</p>
              </td>
              <td className="p-4 text-center"><span className="bg-gray-800 text-gray-300 px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs">{emp.plan}</span></td>
              <td className="p-4 text-center"><span className="bg-gray-900 text-gray-400 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border border-gray-800">{emp.usuarios}</span></td>
              <td className="p-4 text-right font-light text-[#D4AF37]">${emp.totalVentas.toLocaleString('es-AR')}</td>
              <td className="p-4 text-center">
                <span className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border ${emp.activa ? 'bg-[#D4AF37]/10 text-[#D4AF37] border-[#D4AF37]/20' : 'bg-red-900/20 text-red-400 border-red-900'}`}>
                  {emp.activa ? 'ACTIVA' : 'SUSPENDIDA'}
                </span>
              </td>
              <td className="p-4 text-center flex flex-col gap-2 items-center">
                <button onClick={() => handleImpersonar(emp.id)} className="text-xs bg-[#111] border border-gray-700 text-gray-300 hover:text-white hover:border-gray-500 px-3 py-1 rounded transition w-full">Entrar (Soporte)</button>
                <button onClick={() => handleToggleEstado(emp.id, emp.activa)} className={`text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded transition w-full border ${emp.activa ? 'bg-red-900/20 border-red-900 text-red-400 hover:bg-red-900/40' : 'bg-green-900/20 border-green-900 text-green-400 hover:bg-green-900/40'}`}>{emp.activa ? 'Suspender' : 'Activar'}</button>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
          {empresasFiltradas.length === 0 && (
            <tr><td colSpan={6} className="p-8 text-center text-gray-500">No se encontraron empresas.</td></tr>
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>

      <ModalCrearCliente isOpen={modalAbierto} onClose={() => setModalAbierto(false)} onSuccess={cargarDatos} planes={planes} />
    </div>
  );
}
